marketing_description: The DeWALT DCB606C Battery and Charger Kit features a FLEXVOLT 20/60 V battery with 6 Ah capacity, providing a reliable power source for DeWALT 20 V MAX tools. This kit includes a charger for quick charging, with a 90-minute charge time, and is designed with a rugged construction for use on tough job sites. The battery also includes an LED state-of-charge indicator and is backed by a 3-year limited warranty.
